business_summary: Jinhui Mining Incorporation Limited engages in the exploration, mining, processing, and sale of lead, zinc, silver, and other mineral resources in China. Jinhui Mining Incorporation Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Longnan, China. Jinhui Mining Incorporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of Gansu Yate Investment Group Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: Jinhui Mining Incorporation Limited는 중국 내 납, 아연, 은 및 기타 광물 자원의 탐사, 채광, 가공 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. Jinhui Mining Incorporation Limited는 2011년에 설립되었으며 중국 Longnan에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Jinhui Mining Incorporation Limited는 Gansu Yate Investment Group Company Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
